abilities.name: Hellblaster Focus
abilities.text: When you make an attack with a PLASMA weapon, you may re-roll up to Double Rank dice.

abilities.name: Defender of Humanity
abilities.text: Add +Rank Icons to any successful attack against a Mob.

abilities.name: Honour the Chapter (Primaris)
abilities.text: You are subject to the orders of your chapter master, and must honour the beliefs and traditions of your chapter. Your Resolve increases by +1. As a Primaris, you gain +3 Wounds.

abilities.name: Space Marine Implants
abilities.text: You are immune to the Bleeding Condition. You gain +1 bonus dice to any test related to one of the 22 implants (p.75) if the GM agrees it is appropriate.

abilities.name: Tactical Versatility (Ultramarines)
abilities.text: Exemplars of the Codex Astartes, the Ultramarines wage war with the utmost flexibility, able to turn any situation to their advantage. You may Shift for Glory twice as part of a Test. The Chapter trait, not the Tactical Space Marine's archetype ability of the same name (Core p.113). He is an Emperor's Spear, an Ultramarines Successor, and takes the Ultramarines traits (kill-team.md ruling 13).

abilities.name: Pride of Ultramar (Tradition)
abilities.text: The Imperium looks to the Ultramarines as paragons of the virtues of Astartes, and each strives to excel that reputation; strong in body, but restrained in mind, a tactical and clear-headed protector of Humanity. You start each session with 1 Wrath Point instead of 2. A Tradition, not Gene-seed, so it applies to a Primaris: Wrath 1 at the start of each session.

abilities.name: Background
abilities.text: Origin Cunning (+1 Determination); Accomplishment Cleanse and Purge (+1 Max Shock); Goal Advancement (+1 Influence).

talents.name: Deadshot
talents.text: You are a skilled shot, trained to carefully target your enemies' weak points. When you take the Aim action (p.189) and make a Called Shot (p.187) you double the bonus ED you receive.

talents.name: Duty Until Death
talents.text: Whenever you suffer more Wounds than your Max Wounds, you can use this Talent. You may take your next Turn normally; you begin Dying at the end of that Turn. You may choose to take your next Turn immediately after activating this Talent, potentially interrupting an enemy's Turn. If you roll a Complication on any Test, you take a Traumatic Wound.

gear: Backpack ammunition supply for the Heavy Plasma Incinerator (Apocrypha p.352), as an Ammo Backpack (Core p.229): carry 10 more Ammo; came stocked with 3 (in the Plasma count)
Dragonfire Bolt rounds (Spread; ignores Defence bonuses from cover, Core p.230; BOLT weapons only)

detail.personality: A son of the Elara's Veil, raised among the war-tribes of a Chapter long cut off from the Imperium. He cherishes wargear as heirlooms and trades in relics the way his Chapter always has, with whoever keeps its guns firing.

objectives.text: Chapter: recover one intact archeotech device.
Secret: trade it to the Magos for Mechanicus favour, not hand it to the Inquisitor.
